summary: P08 iteration 2 passes the keep gate under the platform verification discipline (Windows dev host + native Linux CI; no WSL, no cross-target). Guardian-as-spawner launch gate: the guardian binary starts before any workload and owns a versioned two-pipe control protocol (pure codec, 64 KiB cap, per-frame version enforcement); the workload is forked with pre-exec prctl(PR_SET_PDEATHSIG)/setpgid/close-3-4/raise(SIGSTOP)-last so zero workload instructions can precede SIGCONT; the daemon receives outer/group/birth identity before persistence and releases exactly once via a consumed gate; EOF before release (daemon death or unreleased Drop) SIGKILLs the stopped group; the workload's inherited descriptor set is empty (pre-exec closes the control fds; s08 asserts fd set subset of {0,1,2} in CI); incompatible or missing guardian refuses fail-closed. unix.rs unit tests (codec) and s08 execute in native Linux CI — honestly not claimed as locally run. QA deep review found no compile-blocking defects (libc signatures, ownership, pre_exec bounds, bounded-wait thread discipline all verified by reading).
